description: Returns the link to the Custom Blinds own-window visualiser, pre-selected to the product when it is supported. The customer adds a photo of their window (any angle), picks a blind and colour, and sees it fitted to their own window. No measuring or marking. A name and WhatsApp number are needed; 2 free previews per customer. Also returns the measuring guide (mode 'measure' makes it the main url) and the list of supported products. A customer still unsure of sizes can order with best guess sizes, receive a free tape measure and confirm before production starts. Use when a customer wants to see how a blind or colour will look before ordering, or is unsure how to measure.

mode.description: Which link goes in url: visualize (own-window visualiser), measure (measuring guide) or both (visualiser, the default). Both links are always returned.

product_id.description: Optional. Pre-select a product in the visualiser (e.g. roller-blockout, double-roller-zebra, outdoor-blinds).

name: get_ar_visualizer_url
